photos.caption: This is the story behind this one — where we were, what we were doing, and why it stuck with us. It started as just another ordinary day, the kind you don't expect to remember, but somewhere in between the small talk and the silly jokes, it turned into something worth holding onto. Maybe it was the way the light hit just right, or maybe it was just the company, but this moment found its way into the collection of memories that make up us. There's a version of this story we tell often, and a version we keep just for ourselves, and this photo sits somewhere in between the two. Every time we look back at it, it brings back the same warmth, the same laugh, the same feeling of being exactly where we were meant to be. It's one of many more still to come, but this one earned its place here, quietly reminding us why we started keeping track of these moments in the first place.
